thesis: The speaker argues that while Google is optimized for quick consumer answers and human clicks, it fails to provide the deep, complete context required for AI agents and complex business queries like finding every global competitor or automating book research. This limitation creates an opportunity for a new type of search engine built specifically for deep understanding and information agents, leveraging recent advances in transformer technology to navigate scattered information that traditional search cannot handle.
